statements.statement: 1. 11-knot: the two four-place parity rules fail K2 in the start and all four finished structures, each inducing {0011,0101,1010,1100}; the other 9 knots and both setting knots pass
2. smallest gain: nae(x1,x2,za) fails K2 at a = 0 inducing {010,011,100,101}; at a = 1 every knot passes; the part and the part after the rule-Q round pass
3 (8-knot part). even(y1,y2,y3,s1) of the 8-knot structure fails K2 in the whole, in the start and with every setting pair; every other knot passes
4 (on these structures). every rule passes on its own
